title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1982-04-19
lineage: 1st generation Reels (Akai GX-625)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90/dolby B)> Frank Streeter's 1st generation 1/4 track Reels @ 3.75 ips (Sony TC770/Maxell UD35-90B)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording captures a solid early‑80s Baltimore show with fine playing and a standout TLEO performance.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers all give this 1982 show four stars, noting the fun vibe, great set list and especially Jerry Garcia’s crisp early‑80s guitar work on “TLEO.” The soundboard source is described as nice with no reported flaws, making it an enjoyable listen for fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive 4‑star reviews highlight strong musical performance and a clean soundboard recording; both show and recording quality are rated good.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific technical complaints; reviewers call the recording "nice" suggesting clear, listenable sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Great set list that keeps momentum and showcases the band having fun.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Early‑80s guitar tone described as perfect, fast and clean; vocals noted as rough but improving later in the decade.
